coverage_note: Georgia has no comprehensive public-sector bargaining statute. The Firefighter's Mediation Act (O.C.G.A. 25-5-1 to 25-5-14) applies only to municipalities that opt in by ordinance. Text is O.C.G.A. release 86 (dated 2022.11) from the Code Revision Commission release mirrored by UniCourt for Public.Resource.Org; later amendments are not reflected, and as_of is set to the release date.

governing_statute.value: No comprehensive statute. Firefighter's Mediation Act, O.C.G.A. 25-5-1 to 25-5-14 (municipal firefighters, local opt-in); public-employee strike ban, O.C.G.A. 45-19-1 et seq.
governing_statute.quote: Firefighters shall have the right to bargain collectively with their respective corporate authorities and to be represented by a labor organization in such collective bargaining as to wages, rates of pay, hours, working conditions, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

labor_board.null_reason: No Georgia statute captured creates a public-sector labor relations board; the firefighter act uses ad hoc mediation boards (O.C.G.A. 25-5-8).

ulp_limitation_period.null_reason: No public-sector unfair labor practice procedure was found in the Georgia titles captured (25 and 45).

who_may_bargain.value: Firefighters of municipalities whose governing authority opts in by ordinance (s. 25-5-14 sets population conditions). No statutory bargaining right was found for other public employees.
who_may_bargain.quote: Before a municipality with a population of 20,000 or more and its firefighters may come under this chapter, the governing authority of the municipality must agree by ordinance that the municipality will be so covered.

impasse_procedure.value: For covered firefighters: issues unresolved 30 days after the first meeting go to a mediation board (O.C.G.A. 25-5-7 to 25-5-11)
impasse_procedure.quote: If the bargaining agent and the corporate authorities are unable, within 30 days from and including the date of their first meeting, to reach an agreement on a contract, any and all unresolved issues shall be submitted to mediation.
